system.description:
Beginning at 6th level, you learn to fuse with your Void Soul becoming your true, fully realized self. As a bonus action, by spending 1 superiority die you place your mask upon your own face and fuse with your Void Soul for up to 1 Minute. While fused, you cannot summon them as a separate creature with Void Soul Awakening. This form ends early if you are unconscious or die. This fusion manifest itself as an aura of chakra in a unique color shade of your choice emanating off of you. While fused you gain the following benefits;

Superego’s Strength. You can cast your Void Souls jutsu.

Superego’s Will. You have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma Saving throws and skill Checks.

Superego’s Influence. Your superego state positively influences all allied creatures within 10 feet of you, granting them a +2 bonus to their attack and damage rolls.
